deprecated_yaml.description:
Configuring InfluxDB using YAML is being removed. Your existing YAML configuration has been imported into the UI automatically.

Remove the `{domain}` configuration from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant to fix this issue.
deprecated_yaml.title: The InfluxDB YAML configuration is being removed

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.description:
Configuring InfluxDB using YAML is being removed but the import failed because Home Assistant could not connect to the InfluxDB server.

Please correct your YAML configuration and restart Home Assistant.

Alternatively you can remove the `{domain}` configuration from your `configuration.yaml` file and continue to [set up the integration]({url}) manually.
deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_conn.title: Failed to import InfluxDB YAML configuration

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.description:

deprecated_yaml_import_issue_invalid_aut.title: [%key:component::influxdb::issues::deprecated_yaml_import_issue_cannot_connect::title%]

data_description.ignore_attributes: These attributes are not written to InfluxDB as fields.
data_description.tags: Tags that are added to every measurement written to InfluxDB.
data_description.tags_attributes: These attributes are written as tags instead of fields.

data_description.component_config: Overrides applied to a single entity.
data_description.component_config_domain: Overrides applied to all entities in a domain.
data_description.component_config_glob: Overrides applied to all entities matching a pattern, for example `sensor.weather_*`.

customize.description: Override the measurement name and ignored attributes for specific entities, entity patterns or domains.
customize.title: Per-entity overrides

filter.description: Choose which entities are written to InfluxDB. When the include filter is empty, everything that is not excluded is written.

data_description.domains: All entities in these domains are excluded.
data_description.entity_globs: Entities matching these patterns are excluded, for example `sensor.weather_*`.

exclude.description: Entities matching one of these are never written to InfluxDB.
exclude.name: Exclude

data_description.domains: All entities in these domains are included.
data_description.entity_globs: Entities matching these patterns are included, for example `sensor.weather_*`.

include.description: Only entities matching one of these is written to InfluxDB.
include.name: Include

filter.title: Entity filter

data_description.default_measurement: Used when the selected source is empty for an entity. Defaults to the entity ID.
data_description.max_retries: How often a failed write is retried before the data is dropped.
data_description.measurement_attr: What the measurement name of an entity is based on.
data_description.override_measurement: Write every entity to this measurement, ignoring the measurement name source.
data_description.precision: The timestamp precision used when writing to InfluxDB.
